declarations.description:
A loop player for an audio file, with the same interface as
video-loop-player and youtube-loop-player: loops, speed, pitch, waveform.
declarations.name: AudioLoopPlayer

members.name: src
members.description: URL of the audio file (required)

members.name: title
members.description: Title shown in the player (default: the file name, without extension)

members.name: showShortcuts
members.description: Show the keyboard shortcuts help ("false" hides it)

members.name: autoRestore
members.description: Restore the loops and settings saved in localStorage ("false" starts fresh)

members.name: storagePrefix
members.description: Prefix of the localStorage keys: give two players of the same media different prefixes

members.name: compact
members.description: Hide the title bar (use when container shows title, e.g., <details><summary>)

members.name: pitch
members.description: Pitch shift in semitones (-12 to +12). Requires pitch shifter processing (SoundTouch).

members.name: showPitchControl
members.description: Show pitch control button (advanced feature)

members.name: mediaIcon
members.description: Media type icon for compact view (e.g., '🎵', '🎬', '📺')

members.name: showExpandButton
members.description: Audio player shows expand button only in minimal mode

members.name: getCompactTitle
members.description: Get the display title for compact view

members.name: initMediaLoad
members.description: Lazy load: start loading audio on first activation (expand or play press)

members.name: exclusive
members.description: When true, starting this player pauses all other exclusive players on the page ("false" turns it off)

members.name: expanded
members.description: Whether the player is expanded (showing full controls) or collapsed (compact view)

members.name: loopEnabled
members.description: Whether loop mode is enabled - reflects to attribute for CSS. Defaults to true (ON); "false" turns it off.

members.name: editMode
members.description: Whether edit mode is active (shows edit panel, drag handles). Always restores as false.

members.name: minimal
members.description: Ultra-compact mode: shows only title + play button + expand chevron (~44px)

members.name: reloadOn
members.description:
Name of a window event that triggers a silent retry when the player is
in the media error state — retry loading after an app-defined recovery
event (e.g. a session restore). No default; the component stays generic.

members.name: getSubtitle
members.description: Get optional subtitle (e.g., channel name). Override in subclass.

members.name: focus
members.description: Focus this player for keyboard shortcuts

members.name: retryMediaLoad
members.description:
Retry loading the media after a failed load. Remembers the playback
position, calls media.load() (re-issuing the network request), and
restores the position on loadedmetadata before clearing the error
state. Loops, pitch, playback rate and other component state live in
component fields and are untouched. Does not auto-play.

members.name: countdownPlay
members.description: Countdown play: 3-2-1 then play from current position

members.name: toggleEditMode
members.description: Toggle between play and edit mode

type.text: { start: number; end: number; isZoomed: boolean }

members.name: toggleZoom
members.description: Toggle zoom to loop

events.description: When a loop is added from the toolbar (`detail.loop`)

declarations.description:
Renders a chord chart written in SNHT notation as a grid, a compact grid
or text. The reader picks the view and the zoom; both are remembered
(localStorage) for every chord grid of the site.
declarations.name: ChordGridElement

members.name: notation
members.description: The chart, in SNHT notation (several lines)

members.name: variant
members.description: The view: 'cells', 'compact' or 'text'. Without the attribute, the reader's last choice, else 'text'

attributes.name: notation
attributes.description: The chart, in SNHT notation (several lines)

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: The view: 'cells', 'compact' or 'text'. Without the attribute, the reader's last choice, else 'text'

declarations.name: parse
declarations.description:
Parse SNHT notation text into a ChordGrid AST.

Supported syntax:
  {time: 3/4}              → time signature directive
  # [Section name]         → section header
  | C . . . | Am . G . |  → measures with chords and beat continuations
  %                        → repeat previous measure
  x2                       → repeat section N times (suffix after last |)

declarations.name: booleanAttribute
declarations.default: { fromAttribute: (value: string | null) => value !== null && value !== 'false', toAttribute: (value: boolean) => (value ? '' : null), }
declarations.description:
Converter for a boolean attribute whose property defaults to true: present
means true, absent or "false" means false (`show-shortcuts="false"` turns
the shortcuts off). Reflection writes an empty attribute or removes it.

declarations.name: LEGACY_ATTRIBUTES
declarations.description: Attribute names before 0.6.0 → their current names.

declarations.name: warnLegacyAttribute
declarations.description: Warns once per element and old attribute name.

declarations.description:
A dialog that enriches the native `<dialog>` it wraps (decision 0010 in
the knowledge base): focus, return value, forms that stay open on error.
The markup and the behaviour are described at the top of this file.
declarations.name: MesnosDialog

members.name: onSubmit
members.description:
Runs on submit of a form of the dialog, buttons disabled meanwhile:
resolves → closes with the value of the submit button ('submit' if
none); resolves to `false` → stays open; rejects → stays open, the
error message in `.dialog-status`. Without it, forms behave natively
(`method="dialog"` closes).

members.name: returnFocus
members.description: Default for open({ returnFocus }).

members.name: dialog
members.description: The native <dialog>, first child element.

members.name: lightDismiss
members.description: Whether a click on the backdrop closes the dialog (`light-dismiss` attribute).

members.name: open
members.description:
Opens as a modal; resolves with the return value on close ('' for
Escape). `options.returnFocus`: focused on close when the element
focused before opening is gone.

members.name: close
members.description: Closes with `value` as the return value.

members.name: setStatus
members.description: Text of the status line (`.dialog-status`, created if needed); '' hides it.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: `md` for a wider dialog (adds the `dialog-md` class)
A click on the backdrop closes the dialog
attributes.name: light-dismiss

declarations.name: confirmDialog
declarations.description: Asks for a confirmation: true for the confirm button, false otherwise (Cancel, ✕, Escape, backdrop).

declarations.name: alertDialog
declarations.description: Shows a message; resolves once it is dismissed.
